name: Deposit by Ouroboros
description: Stores a freelancer's approved deposit and later payment dates, and what an assistant may tell the client. An AI assistant cannot waive the deposit, mark it paid, or move a payment date unless that change is explicitly approved. Tools: list_schedules, start_schedule, read_schedule, record_deposit, add_later_payment, move_payment_date, waive_deposit, mark_deposit_paid, write_client_script, commit_schedule, suggest_schedule_change, accept_schedule_change. Hosted remote endpoint with OAuth and Dynamic Client Registration; requires an account. Docs: https://ouroborosapps.com/docs/deposit. Published in the Official MCP Registry as io.github.LAHutchins91/deposit. Made by Ouroboros Apps (https://ouroborosapps.com).
author: Ouroboros
